title: Keep an unfinished check open when a nonterminal launcher reply reuses its key for a different command
outcome: A mismatched Running plus NotFinished reply cannot silently end the different command still open under that key.
acceptance: A regression drives the real recorder with an open command and a different focused launcher Running/NotFinished reply under its key, and preserves the original unfinished check and honest terminal notice.
Existing matching launcher handling and non-launcher Success/NotFinished launch acknowledgements retain their intended behavior.
